label: EXTREME HEAT + LOW FLOW + GRID STRESS
selection_basis: Tests a climate-to-water-to-energy chain with optional observation and technology modifiers.
boundary: No health outcome, outage probability, or compound severity is modeled.

label: HARMFUL ALGAL BLOOM / WATER-QUALITY PRESSURE + WATER-TREATMENT DISRUPTION
selection_basis: Tests the bounded nutrient-water-quality, water-operations, observation, ecology, and governance interfaces.
boundary: No bloom magnitude, treatment failure, exposure, dose, illness, or risk score is modeled.

label: FREIGHT / MATERIAL DISRUPTION + INDUSTRIAL ENERGY CONSTRAINT
selection_basis: Tests generalized logistics, material input, energy, workforce, and coordination interfaces.
boundary: No exact route, quantity, contract, production, or market forecast is modeled.

label: INFECTIOUS-DISEASE PRESSURE + SURVEILLANCE / DATA-GOVERNANCE FRICTION
selection_basis: Tests surveillance, diagnostics, workforce, communication, stewardship, and coordination without epidemiological forecasting.
boundary: High-level only: no pathogen engineering, transmission optimization, evasion, lab procedure, incidence, or outbreak probability.

label: HEAVY PRECIPITATION / FLOODING + INFRASTRUCTURE / LOGISTICS DISRUPTION
selection_basis: Tests event-scale water, freight, energy, and aggregate population interfaces.
boundary: No flood extent, route loss, damage, outage probability, or population harm is modeled.

label: CYBER / DIGITAL-RESILIENCE STRESS + SENSOR / DECISION-SUPPORT DEGRADATION
selection_basis: Tests observation, communications, defensive cyber, technology coupling, and manual fallback boundaries.
boundary: No operational attack details, exploit path, sensitive topology, or automatic control claim is modeled.
